name: Contract Blade

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: Turning the diabolic powers of a contract inward, you cause the paper to fold and sharpen into a deadly blade. When you Interact to draw your contract folio, you can use a free action with the manipulate trait to transform it into a weapon. A contract blade deals 1d6 slashing damage, is a simple weapon in the sword group, and has the finesse, magical, and parry traits. If the blade leaves your hands, it returns to its original form. You can buy and inscribe fundamental weapon runes and weapon property runes into your folio in the same way you would for a regular weapon, and they apply to your contract blade. You can move runes to and from your folio to other weapons or runestones for the usual cost.
